The challenge to work on a passage of the game (or other significant edits) every single day since 2023 paid off and is over! Thank you to everyone who has ever reached out about the game over the years. I cannot express how much those messages have meant to me. They've kept me motivated to write, knowing that there will be someone on the other end receiving the message. The Lifeline fandom is special, and the best fandom I've ever been in. And Sugar? Thank you for being such a good friend over the years. You are a wonderful artist, a smart and clever rp partner, and have generally made my life so much more joyful by our chats and friendship. <span class="owo">OwO</span> I promise T2ylor gets home, and I promise they will both be okay in the end. May you always find your home. --Holly/PekaSairroc P.S. Please report typos and bugs! To shout out my favorite board game, //We Didn't Playtest This at All//, I didn't playtest this at all. It ended up feeling more like someone else's research paper and experiment that I was only going to run. A ship of Theseus. A research project of Theseus. (Don't tell my Classics-nerd friend I said that. She //hates// Theseus.) That's not all bad. It showed I had //something// that was interesting, and my original experiment probably wouldn't have stood the test of time--or more eternally and inevitably: publishing submissions. ...But it wasn't my own anymore. Some things are simply not meant for our mortal minds. All I know is that the occupiers shouldn't be on Earth yet, since I broke the time loop, and Captain Shepherd likely fought them off. I want to keep it that way, and warn Earth of the danger in a better way. Maybe through a concept album. Captain Shepherd absolutely has a good head on her shoulders and will take care of the doctor and get Aya home safely. And Mari Lee? She's tough, and kind, and caring, and... ...oh man, I'm making myself tear up a bit thinking about her. She has a second chance against the marines, and I hope she's okay. I did the best I could for her. I hope that's enough. All I know is that the occupiers shouldn't be on Earth yet, since I broke the time loop, and Captain Shepherd likely fought them off. The greens have taken so much from me. I don't want to lose the part of myself that cries from the loss of a life. I have no sympathy for the greens. What they've done to both crews is beyond words. I saw that same green tint in my own spit that were in their eyes as they ripped each other apart. I know the real reason now but... I am in this mess whether I like it or not. (I do not like it.) You're my lifeline back to earth, back to home. Back to humanity and normality ('What is normal anyway?'). And I don't want to lose that. {{(if: $tort is 1)[Hey, make sure that T2 doesn't... you know.] (else:)[Thanks for checking in on me. Came home crying in 2nd grade because I failed a math test and my life was over.</span> Yeah. I was. Inconsolable. Got signed up for space camp that night. <span class="t2">And math tutoring lessons I begged my mom for.</span> I was //seven//. What type of seven year old begs their parents for a math tutor? <span class="t2">Numbers never made the most sense to me.</span></span>(stop:) ]] |more>[] (live: 95s)[(transition: "dissolve")[<span class="comms">`[Taylor and T2 are listening]` </span>(stop:) ]] |more>[] (live: 173s)[(transition: "dissolve")[<span class="t2">Freshman year I tried out all the clubs I could from the student fair and since the pictures were taken at the beginning of the year, it looked like I was in so many clubs. That dropped right off after the first quarter when I was pulling all nighters and waking up early to go to astronomy club and see the early morning stars.</span> First quarter was miserable because I just wanted to prove that I was the best student who could do school really well, and learn things really well... ...and do clubs really well, and make friends really well. And maybe do other things really well too. So I could get into a good school that would take me to the space program. That obviously didn't work and I got crunched under that stress. It'll be an album of all time, that's to say the least.</spn> [[A trio or duo?]] [[I'll pre-order it.]]{ (if: $starTay is "starsick")[ Why would that happen? <br> The Stars wouldn't do that to us. I know that. <br> Space isn't as deadly as I once thought— it's like I always hoped it would be. <br> Sure, there are some dangers here. There are dangers everywhere, including Earth. <br> But that's what life out here is. <br> <br> <br> [[Fewer dangers out there, but worse ones.]] <br> [[Maybe not a meteor, but it'll be something else.]] ] (if: $starTay is "excited")[ Why would that happen? <br> Meteors aren't flying around everywhere out here. <br> (And they're called asteroids out here in space! Meteors are if they're flying through the atmosphere.) <br> We aren't in a Galactica game, despite previous encounters with debris out here. <br> But those were contained and we would have been fine if we didn't have to EVA. <br> There's not much out here to randomly kill us. <br> <br> <br> [[What if you DO have to EVA again?]] <br> [[Thats right. There's nothing out there.]] ] (if: $starTay is "angry")[ Why do you think the Stars would do that to us? <br> They don't hate us. They don't want to kill us. <br> They just exist and aren't out to harm anyone. <br> They don't decide to chuck a meteor at us and say "PLAY BALL!" <br> <br> <br> [[The stars aren't sentient, Taylor.]] <br> [[How's your swingin' arm?]] ] (if: $starTay is "scared")[ What are the chances of that? <br> In a universe this big, and space so spread out, what are the chances that a tiny—but sizable—asteroid would fly through the sky, impact us, cause enough damage that we'd die, and then we'd die from decompression? <br> <br> <br> [[Not nil, that's for sure.]] <br> [[You have extreme luck, good and bad.]] ] (if: $starTay is "lonely")[ We're not going to get hit with a meteor. <br> There's a lot of empty space out here, full of stardust and potentially tourist-trap asteroids... <br> ...but no rampaging asteroids. <br> If we DO get hit by one I don't think there'd be anyone to catch our SOS. <br> You'd be there, I'm sure, but you can't perform emergency care outside of emergency consult. <br> <br> <br> [[No space-ambulances.]] <br> [[I'm no doctor or pilot.]] ] } (set: $TayQuestions to $TayQuestions - 1) (set: $Q1 to 1){ (if: $starTay is "starsick")[ I complain about a lot of things. <br> It's a way to deal with the inconveniences of spaceflight. <br> The food is something I'll get used to. We can grow better food. <br> <br> <br> [[Key lime pie grows on trees.]] <br> [[Going vegetarian are you?]] ] (if: $starTay is "excited")[ Yes. It's worth complaining about. <br> There are some flavors that don't play nice with the others. <br> Some spices that need a breakup and some time alone to learn about who they are... as spices. <br> Or there are no spices or flavorings at all. <br> The Varia didn't come with much besides extra salt and pepper, which most MREs provide already in convenient tiny packets. <br> What if we find some extraterrestrial spices? <br> <br> <br> [[They'd likely be toxic.]] <br> [[That requires landing the Varia.]] ] (if: $starTay is "angry")[ I know! They're bad! <br> All MREs are is nutrition and calories packaged up into something pretending to be comfort instead of a soylent bar. <br> I'd almost prefer soylent green. <br> Have you ever tried MREs? <br> (Besides Chili Mac, obviously, that's the only savior for our tastebuds.) <br> <br> <br> [[Buddy, they're not THAT bad.]] <br> [[You're proving my point.]] ] (if: $starTay is "scared")[ Complaining for humor's sake—or because if I stop complaining the world will stop turning as mom puts it— is one of my coping mechanisms. <br> It's something I can do to help my problems, even if it doesn't ACTUALLY help the problems. <br> It makes me feel like I'm solving it by bringing it to the attention of someone light years or more away from me! <br> <br> <br> [[That someone can't send you food.]] <br> [[A hungry mouth that just complains.]] ] (if: $starTay is "lonely")[ In space, no one else can hear your complaints. <br> Except you, my lifeline. <br> You READ my complaints. <br> But if I turn off my comms and unleash the best complaint the galaxy ever read on Galaxy Yelp about the texture, solidity, and sulfurous content of the beans of the infamous Chili With Beans dish... <br> Then that would be fine by me. <br> <br> <br> [[Aww, I want to hear that!]] <br> [[I'm still not convinced it's that bad.]] ] } (set: $TayQuestions to $TayQuestions - 1) (set: $Q2 to 1){ (if: $starTay is "starsick")[ ....... <br> He has my brother and sister... <br> My mom and dad... <br> They all love him. <br> <br> <br> [[But he chose YOU.]] <br> [[You're happy just leaving him?]] ] (if: $starTay is "excited")[ ... <br> He... he has the rest of my family. <br> My brother... my sister... <br> My mom and dad.... <br> They love him too. Just as much as I do. <br> He'll have many happy memories of them. <br> Just not of me. I'm not in his story anymore. <br> I do miss him. <br> I miss the heat of his little furry bottom on my lap. <br> Or the weight and pokeyness of his claws when he was my alarm clock. <br> (It was a mutually beneficial relationship: I woke up in time for school AND to slip him an extra teaspoon of mashed up salmon.) <br> <br> <br> [[He doesn't have YOU.]] <br> [[Give him one more extra teaspoon, Taylor.]] ] (if: $starTay is "angry")[ Why are you trying to guilt me into going back? <br> Do you think I not care about him? <br> <br> <br> [[He misses you, Taylor.]] <br> [[I'm not guilting you!]] ] (if: $starTay is "scared")[ .... <br> He doesn't know what happened, does he? <br> Taylor hugged and kissed him and fed him an extra treat and looked worried... <br> ...then a few months later the rest of the family did the same. <br> Then nothing else changed. <br> I wonder if he's doing alright. <br> <br> <br> [[You won't know until you're back home.]] <br> [[It won't be your fault.]] ] (if: $starTay is "lonely")[ It would be nice to hear him purr again. <br> To feel the weight of his body leaning against mine. <br> Wake up to a playful tail in my face... or a cat butt in my face... or if I REALLY don't wake up on time... <br> ...a claw combing my hair and scalp. <br> <br> <br> [[He was waiting for you. Don't make him wait longer.]] <br> [[A beautiful cat with beautiful shows of affection.]] ] } (set: $TayQuestions to $TayQuestions - 1) (set: $Q3 to 1){ (if: $starTay is "starsick")[ It's "stellar" radiation, not the type from the Varia's engine. <br> It's fine. <br> <br> <br> [[It is definitely NOT fine.]] <br> [[We don't know all the damage it causes.]] ] (if: $starTay is "excited")[ Stellar radiation sounds pretty rad actually. <br> The Stars' energy coursing through my veins... <br> Did you know we're already made of Stars? <br> We're made from the chemicals made from exploding stars. <br> We're stardust. <br> ...Starstuff. <br> Adding some stellar radiation is sprinkling sprinkles on the banana split of supernova debris. <br> As in: very good flavoring. <br> <br> <br> [[Carl Sagan said that line.]] <br> [[I prefer sundaes.]] ] (if: $starTay is "angry")[ Look, lifeline, I know we talk about danger a lot since it comes up in my life A LOT. <br> But can you chill on the danger alarm for a minute? <br> Not everything is imminent death out here, or anywhere. <br> Many things are, but this isn't something we can control and there's radiation at home. <br> You're beginning to sound like a glitchy proximity alarm klaxon. <br> <br> <br> [[Radiation is everywhere, Taylor.]] <br> [[The proximity alarm hasn't let you down yet.]] ] (if: $starTay is "scared")[ You think? The exposure rates aren't THAT high. <br> Tons of astronauts have been exposed to this stuff and didn't end up dying prematurely. <br> Why would it be any different for us? <br> <br> [[It'd be a full lifetime of exposure.]] <br> [[No medical help in case there's something.]] ] (if: $starTay is "lonely")[ Stellar radiation, like a hug from the Stars? <br> That actually sounds comforting, like they're always out here with us. <br> (The Stars ARE. I know that.) <br> <br> <br> [[And slowly killing you.]] <br> [[A mutanagenic hug.]] ] } (set: $TayQuestions to $TayQuestions - 1) (set: $Q4 to 1){ (if: $starTay is "starsick")[ They are fuzzy little friends, yes. <br> I would like to hug them, and cuddle them... <br> ...but I shouldn't base my entire goals and opportunities for life decisions on the hope of a few rat snuggles. <br> <br> <br> [[I would base my entire goals on them.]] <br> [[You're missing out on a joy of life.]] ] (if: $starTay is "excited")[ Oh man. I forgot about my rats. <br> The "rat" part of my rats. Not the horrible intro to the green experience with them. <br> They weren't fuzzy but I know what you mean. <br> I like to think I'm good with animals since they never bit me— <br> —Outside of when I grabbed them from zero gravity the first time they experienced it. <br> <br> <br> [[Tell me more about them.]] <br> [[Aw, rat kisses.]] ] (if: $starTay is "angry")[ I would. I would, lifeline. <br> But I also have some major problems and decisions in my life that need attending to. <br> An emotional support rodent isn't going to help solve them. <br> Unless that rodent comes out from the Stars and starts speaking in riddles and cooking me a homemade dish of spinach and cheese quiche. <br> THEN I'll consider rats helping me through this current crisis. <br> <br> <br> [[What if I come by and cook that up for you?]] <br> [[You require so many specific things, Taylor.]] ] (if: $starTay is "scared")[ I'm assuming the non-infected breed is the type you're talking about. <br> You have the Zucker rats as the rorbs (rat orbs), the Long-Evans rats with the hoods... <br> You have the Sprague-Dawley rats with albinism and love (like mine were)... <br> And you have the Occupier-Greens rats like they became. <br> <br> <br> [[Those are stuck on the moon.]] <br> [[The biologist in you is showing.]] ] (if: $starTay is "lonely")[ Oh man. I do miss my rats. <br> When they weren't ripping each other to shreds to release an alien to be shoved into my mouth to turn me into one of them and do the same to the next person I see. <br> That's a heavy caveat to this longing. <br> I could do with some little rodent legs running along my shoulders and neck again. <br> <br> <br> [[Well, what are you waiting for?]] <br> [[You'll find non-infected ones at home.]] ] (set: $TayQuestions to $TayQuestions - 1) (set: $Q5 to 1) }{ (if: $starTay is "starsick")[ Warn Earth about what, exactly? <br> We're free of the greens right now and as long as they don't leave the moon, Earth will be. <br> Remember what the Green Squad said? <br> If we get back, we'll get gotten when we land. <br> And when we get gotten when we land, we'll get the rest of humanity in this universe gotten. <br> Get it? <br> <br> <br> [[We can avoid them on landing.]] <br> [[Got it.]] ] (if: $starTay is "excited")[ Good luck convincing space explorers to avoid a place with extremely valuable rocks to dig up. <br> That lure is how ASTRA got a few missions funded. <br> I'd worry they'd take the idea as an incentive to eliminate The Green Problem(TM) without being prepared for it. <br> We don't know how to solve it, so we don't come with a solution, only a grievance. <br> (I know I LOVE to complain about food and minor bumps... <br> ...but this reaches up a few more levels.) <br> <br> <br> [[Then be the solution.]] <br> [[The manager already explained what would happen.]] ] (if: $starTay is "angry")[ What do you really think we could do? <br> We give them a heads up on their fully-funded project to mine tons of—extremely expensive—magical radiation-storing rocks? <br> Nothing will change. There's too much money in it. <br> (Money is the root of many exploratory evils, even though it funds science missions.) <br> (Let's face it: science is expensive. Do you realize I was costing ASTRA about $150,000 a day?) <br> (Incredible, isn't it?) <br> (Needs more funding.) <br> <br> <br> [[PWG can help you.]] <br> [[Can I get paid?]] ] (if: $starTay is "scared")[ Do you think anyone will listen? <br> The whole story is outlandish and belongs in fiction. <br> Imagine: a missing astronaut comes home finally and starts ranting and raving about green aliens that climb in your mouth and control you. <br> Also this astronaut don't know enough math or has any pilot training to fly the ship back. <br> They're going to ask a lot of questions, and investigate themselves. <br> Which <br> led to the recon crew being sent in the first place. <br> <br> [[T2's eyes make a good case.]] <br> [[Convince them not to send anyone.]] ] (if: $starTay is "lonely")[ I don't think they'll avoid a place that can net them so much money. <br> That payload of tunguskite was worth more than than my bum. <br> And T2's bum. <br> Combined. <br> And you know that florally-burned bum is worth so much. <br> At least as much as Watney's. <br> <br> <br> [[Thats a few billion each if the calculator's right.]] <br> [[Florally-burned?]] ] } (set: $TayQuestions to $TayQuestions - 1) (set: $Q6 to 1){ (if: $starTay is "starsick")[I have a feeling—whenever I look at the scars on the back of my hand... <br> ...constellations swirling... <br> —that the Stars will guide me away from them. <br> .... <br> I'm not worried about the greens. <br> <br> <br> [[I am worried.]] <br> [[That makes zero sense, Taylor.]] ] (if: $starTay is "excited")[ Then we'll deal with them again. Ever. <br> It's also an echo out here. <br> A lonely echo. <br> <br> <br> [[That's too much Taylor to hear.]] <br> [[Echoes come from somewhere.]] ] } (set: $TayQuestions to $TayQuestions - 1) (set: $Q17 to 1){ (if: $starTay is "starsick")[ It's very damaged, that's very true. <br> But we've fared well so far, even through a debris storm! <br> Maybe we're lucky. <br> <br> <br> [[Lucky for now.]] <br> [[How would you ever repair it?!]] ] (if: $starTay is "excited")[ ...... <br> 'Tis but a scratch! <br> <br> <br> [[A scratch? Your bloody arm's off!]] <br> [[You'll be the flesh wound.]] ] (if: $starTay is "angry")[ I know. It's a wreck. I'm a wreck. <br> We're all wrecks! <br> Isn't this a great home for us three wrecks? <br> Sailing along in so much wreckage! <br> <br> <br> [[Excuse me, I'M not a wreck.]] <br> [[Earth is a wreck too!]] ] (if: $starTay is "scared")[ I am //well// aware of how precarious that position is. <br> Especially after the debris storm. <br> It may be a matter of time before we die from explosive decompression anyway. <br> I hope not but that //is// a thought that flashes through my mind every time I walk past the astromap room. <br> <br> <br> [[What do the system checks say?]] <br> [[Is it fixable?]] ] (if: $starTay is "lonely")[ We do have a giant hole in the side of our only habitat. <br> The only thing keeping us from certain explosive decompressive death is a hydraulic door that might also be damaged. <br> There is a lot of nothing between us and safety. <br> <br> <br> [[A LOT of a lot of nothing.]] <br> [[I legitimately can't believe it's still working.]] ] } (set: $TayQuestions to $TayQuestions - 1) (set: $Q18 to 1){ (if: $starTay is "starsick")[ They're ancient and young. <br> They're full of wisdom shining bright. <br> Burning and shining, shining and burning. <br> They've guided travelers home for all of time. <br> Wherever that home is. <br> How could I not? <br> <br> <br> [[Their home, not your home.]] <br> [[Easy. Trust me instead.]] ] (if: $starTay is "excited")[ Have you ever had a chance to look out at the stars at night? <br> On a clear night— maybe in rural countryside. No cities. <br> Well, if you haven't, you haven't. <br> I don't think you could understand me without that. <br> <br> <br> [[As a matter of fact I have.]] <br> [[I understand you enough as it is.]] ] (if: $starTay is "angry")[ I keep telling you but you never believe me. Or listen. <br> No, you do listen, but I don't think you understand. <br> I didn't understand and I don't think T2 fully understands yet. <br> The Stars are something so old and ancient but always new and full of birth and change. <br> They're ancient ways of life and the future unfolding. <br> Humans have always had that connection with the Stars. Recently though, there's light pollution and smog and less time to simply stargaze. <br> Out here I can and I can listen... in a way. <br> That's why I trust them. <br> <br> <br> [[Come back to the desert on Earth.]] <br> [[Humans moreso have connection with the Earth.]] ] (if: $starTay is "scared")[ If I'm being honest. If I'm being frank. If I'm being blunt... <br> I don't know why I trust the Stars. <br> But I do. <br> I know I do and that my trust isn't lethal alien thrall. <br> This is peaceful in a way I know is right— I've known it all my life. <br> It's not a new feeling like with the occupiers' thrall. <br> <br> <br> [[Well, you //sound// like you did on that moon.]] <br> [[Sus if you don't know.]] ] (if: $starTay is "lonely")[ The Stars have been with me all my life. <br> When I was a little kid— barely able to walk— I was taken stargazing at a roadside outlook in the city outskirts. <br> They're the same Stars as then. The same Stars peacefully watching me all throughout life, every night. <br> Every night on Earth, every night out here in space. <br> Even when every other human was far away... <br> ...or only there by a quark's twist. <br> <br> <br> [[You're still so far away from everyone.]] <br> [[And what have they done for you?]] ] } (set: $TayQuestions to $TayQuestions - 1) (set: $Q19 to 1){ (if: $starTay is "starsick")[ Home is where you come from and where you come back to after a long day or long life. <br> It's what you miss after you've been on a long journey. <br> The joy of missing home for the first time when you've been away so long... <br> ...and the joy of arriving back on the doorstep. <br> <br> <br> [[You're tripping on a nonexistent doorstep out here.]] <br> [[So... that means that you'll miss Earth?]] ] (if: $starTay is "excited")[ Where the comms automatically connects! I'm looking for a solid 10G connection! <br> (This is a wifi joke— I don't know if you have wifi in your universe.) <br> (Wifi is wireless internet connection.) <br> <br> <br> [[Taylor, I know what Wi-fi is.]] <br> [[10G, eh? Twice as fast as ours.]] ] (if: $starTay is "angry")[ Home is the place that's special to you. We all have a home. <br> Okay, maybe not //everyone//, but that's an issue— we want everyone to have a home. <br> Somewhere they're safe and can be themselves. That's what I want. For myself. <br> And I deserve to have that. <br> I've suffered enough. <br> <br> <br> [[You have a home on Earth.]] <br> [[Such a martyr Taylor is.]] ] (if: $starTay is "scared")[ Home? I'd call it a place where I can relax and let my guard down. <br> It's the place I know is just for me and the people I invite in, whether that's temporary visits or a permanent part of my life. <br> It's safety. It's a hug in the familiar. <br> It's knowing nothing here will do me harm, or at least harm with malice. <br> (Kitchen appliances are beasts, even if they aren't malicious). <br> <br> <br> [[The vastness of space is safe?]] <br> [[What is malicious then?]] ] (if: $starTay is "lonely")[ Home is where the people you love are. Or the things you love to do are. <br> It can be a location rather than a house: a town, a city, even a forest or park. <br> Nearby all those things or people but still your very own sanctuary. <br> Otherwise it's just a place you live. <br> <br> [[And you won't live in this place for long.]] <br> [[The people you love aren't out in space.]] ] } (set: $TayQuestions to $TayQuestions - 1) (set: $Q20 to 1){<span class="t2"> (if: $starT2 is "starsick")[That is a good point you have there. <br> I do need a shower. <br> And WILL need a shower again in the future. <br> (That's how showers work— you never see the end of 'em!) <br> But maybe that's how space life has to be: <br> Always needing something and being grateful for what you do get. <br> <br> <br> [[That's no way to live.]] <br> [[Live a little. Go back to nice things.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "excited")[Good point. I'll miss showers. <br> But I've already missed them for... it's gotta be AT LEAST half a year since I've taken a real one. <br> I got used to the "fake" ones that astronauts use— dry shampoo and dabs of water. <br> I might be able to engineer a fun setup like the watering can trick if we can confirm the water filtration system is working correctly. <br> <br> <br> [[Can you ever confirm that?]] <br> [[You can't be happy with that setup.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "angry")[Yeah. Those could be out unless we get the water filtration working very well. <br> But that's not the point! <br> The point is that I'm willing to give up nice showers to stay here in safety. <br> (And in a bit of adventure.) <br> None of the old explorers got a chance to take leisurely showers when they were off doing their research and making discoveries! <br> It comes with the job. <br> <br> <br> [[I'm sure they missed their showers too.]] <br> [[Seriously, you stink.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "scared")[Showers ARE relaxing. <br> Like comforting rain or a splash in the face to come back to what's important. <br> (We only would get the later out here.) <br> (Can't say that it's relaxing.) <br> I would miss them. I really would. <br> <br> <br> [[Then don't leave them.]] <br> [[You deserve a spa day when you get home.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "lonely")[Hey, at least the only people who will ever smell us will be ourselves. <br> I know hygiene is important and I intend to follow it for my own sake (and Taylor's)... <br> ...but you also don't mind your own smells. <br> It's science, with personal smell receptors. <br> <br> <br> [[It's unhygienic, come on.]] <br> [[You'd look and feel better with water pressure.]] ] } (set: $T2Questions to $T2Questions - 1) (set: $Q21 to 1){<span class="t2"> (if: $starT2 is "starsick")[ <span class="t2"> We do, don't we? <br> We can make them last somehow—we're smart. <br> There's also the enormity of space to explore and find supplies. <br> Water on freezing comet tails... <br> Food on undiscovered planets and moons... <br> The universe is full of supplies we can use. <br> <br> <br> [[How, exactly, do you plan on harvesting those?]] <br> [[Land yourself on a comet, sure.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "excited")[ <span class="t2"> That's true, but I can find ways of making them last longer. <br> Water can always be recycled, along with air. <br> Medical supplies can be rationed and then we'll find substitutes. <br> As far as food goes, Watney got a few potatoes to last for over 500 Sols! <br> I'm sure I can rig something up in my lab to make some MREs and freeze-dried samples flourish. <br> I'm a biological science student after all. <br> <br> <br> [[A real genius of a student, I'm sure.]] <br> [[Watney almost starved with his potatoes.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "angry")[ <span class="t2"> Of course I know that! <br> Do you think that I think starship supplies grow on trees? <br> There aren't even trees on this ship. <br> We have to get creative. Grow our own food. Recycle our own water. <br> Watney did it. We can do it. <br> <br> <br> [[Watney wasn't a student.]] <br> [[What about non-perishables?]] ] (if: $starT2 is "scared")[ <span class="t2"> That's a limiting factor, I admit. <br> An important limiting factor. <br> One we'll constantly be dealing with. <br> Ugh. Unending food anxiety. <br> And water anxiety. <br> And ship repair anxiety. <br> That one would be an unsatisfactory situation. <br> <br> <br> [[There are ship supplies on Tau Ceti...]] <br> [[Aren't you supposed to be a star science student?]] ] (if: $starT2 is "lonely")[ <span class="t2"> It's only two people on this starship. <br> They'll last a while. <br> We can count them and ration it out with the extra time we have. <br> Then maybe we can find some other lonely astronauts to trade supplies with. <br> <br> <br> [[What do you have to offer?]] <br> [[How many astronauts are out there?]] ] } (set: $T2Questions to $T2Questions - 1) (set: $Q22 to 1){<span class="t2"> (if: $starT2 is "starsick")[ <span class="t2"> Yes I did, in a way. <br> It wasn't first on my mind and research isn't the most important thing in life and the universe. <br> I've learned that out here. <br> There's more than just knowledge— there's exploration and adventure. <br> <br> <br> [[And death.]] <br> [[You don't care about learning?]] ] (if: $starT2 is "excited")[ <span class="t2"> I didn't forget. I've just had a lot more on my mind the past couple of months. <br> What with all the sci-fi and alien drama. <br> Research tends to get put on the back burner when I get burned. <br> That's the function of a back burner—to burn your food— if I know my way around the kitchen any. <br> Anyway, I didn't forget about them, but it's hard to conduct rat research without the rats. <br> <br> <br> [[Didn't you also research lichen?]] <br> [[Earth has a larger supply of rats than space.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "angry")[ <span class="t2"> I've had other things on my mind. IN my mind too. <br> The Greens do most of their research interventionally rather than observationally. <br> I knew that Regina was using me as an experiment. I was the first—the first in my universe—it turns out, to have more control over myself while still being loyal to her. <br> I hate being a lab rat. I didn't get any cheese or ear scratches. <br> <br> <br> [[You're a cute lab rat at least.]] <br> [[Are you sure that's all she used you for?]] ] (if: $starT2 is "scared")[ <span class="t2"> I can't forget what my research led me to. <br> It led me to Tau Ceti. It led me to the peak. <br> It led me to not run screaming from my rats. <br> I don't remember know how I got out of the peak, except "barely." <br> I think the White Star crew was more proactive in their rescue than Taylor's was. <br> ...I don't remember them coming at all. <br> I was so done with trying to survive and ready to give up and wave the white flag. <br> The sea of green spreading out all across my vision.... <br> <br> <br> [[You'll never have to deal with that again.]] <br> [[Your research!!]] ] (if: $starT2 is "lonely")[ <span class="t2"> My research had taken a backseat to survival against aliens. <br> It's why you need to find the sciences— who knows what information on rat behavior I could have learned with some bodyguards to protect me while I took notes! <br> I had the Varia crew for most of it. <br> Colby and Adair ran the show with Captain Aya while me, Antoine, and Trotter worked on our projects. <br> <br> <br> [[Dedicate your findings to them.]] <br> [[No one can protect you out here.]] ] } (set: $T2Questions to $T2Questions - 1) (set: $Q23 to 1){<span class="t2"> (if: $starT2 is "starsick")[ <span class="t2"> Hey, it's not because we hate each other. <br> We don't. We've struggled with self-reflection this entire trip. <br> It's been a test and we've been testy with each other. <br> We're growing and this is a personal journey for us. <br> Living with ourselves, you know? <br> We can do that in space. Alone with ourself. <br> <br> <br> [[That's not supposed to be literal.]] <br> [[Here is my vote of no confidence.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "excited")[ <span class="t2"> You have the utmost confidence in us. Thank you. <br> I would have guessed it'd have been much less, considering my plan was to infect Taylor on the second or third day on the Viridian. <br> I DID manage to hold off on murder or infection these past few weeks on this Viridian. <br> (Besides those greens near the beginning.) <br> <br> <br> [[It hasn't been nearly that long for me.]] <br> [[Congratulations. Keep it up.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "angry")[ <span class="t2"> If Taylor wasn't being so difficult then we wouldn't fight. <br> But as it is, it won't be my fault. I plead innocence. <br> Taylor will start anything that MAY happen. <br> I use my experience to REACT to it. <br> It's the way that innocence and naivety functions. <br> <br> <br> [[Don't get out of control.]] <br> [[You just said YOU were innocent.]]] (if: $starT2 is "scared")[ <span class="t2"> You... do you actually think that will happen? <br> Sure, we fight a bit, but YOU try living with yourself for a few weeks. <br> All those problems, especially interpersonal ones that you try to ignore, become so clear when they're happening to YOU. <br> And you slowly wonder how anyone has ever put up with you for more than a handful of minutes. <br> <br> <br> [[I wonder that sometimes too.]] <br> [[You're better than you fear.]]] (if: $starT2 is "lonely")[ <span class="t2"> You think I'd murder my only source of in-person company? <br> Within a week? <br> Lifeline, I appreciate you, I really REALLY do. <br> But it does feel different having someone here with me— physically here with me— that your text on the screen doesn't give. <br> No offense. <br> <br> <br> [[Fine, I'm chopped liver.]] <br> [[I take that as a no about murder.]] ] } (set: $T2Questions to $T2Questions - 1) (set: $Q24 to 1){<span class="t2"> (if: $starT2 is "starsick")[ <span class="t2"> Do I trust Taylor? <br> That's a thinly veiled jab on whether I trust myself. <br> Since Taylor is myself. <br> I think I trust Taylor. <br> And myself. <br> I trust myself. <br> <br> <br> [[My question was if you trust Taylor.]] <br> [[Taylor trusts too easily.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "excited")[ <span class="t2"> Why wouldn't I trust Taylor? <br> Taylor has been looking out for me ever since I spat that alien out. <br> Even before, back in the Viridian, offering some help in gauzing up my complexion and giving me a facial. <br> (As good as that sounded at the time, I had to decline. <br> Beauty products are a weakness of the greens, FYI.) <br> <br> <br> [[You were betrayed by a Taylor, too.]] <br> [[You still order Taylor around.]]] (if: $starT2 is "angry")[ <span class="t2"> I'm not sure I'm following what you're saying. <br> You're asking me, the person who tricked your friend and nearly killed your lifeline-ee... <br> ...whether I trust— <br> You should ask Taylor if //I'm// to be trusted. <br> Not if //I// trust Taylor. <br> <br> <br> [[Hit a sore spot did I?]] <br> [[What do you think Taylor will say?]] ] (if: $starT2 is "scared")[ <span class="t2"> Should I not? <br> Actual question shooting right back at ya. <br> I mean it. I'll listen. <br> Or at least take what you say into my best consideration, which, having known me... <br> ....you know that's not my strong suit. <br> <br> <br> [[I think you should trust Taylor.]] <br> [[I think you shouldn't trust Taylor.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "lonely")[ <span class="t2"> Who else is there to trust out here? <br> Sure, YOU'RE here, but it's not the same. You're not HERE. <br> I can see my—Taylor's— expression to judge what is being said. <br> I can't see yours. I can't see if you're not confident in some choices... if you're worried about what you're getting us into, if you know something we don't. <br> I don't know that with you. Taylor is an open book—another reason I kept the old helmet on. <br> <br> <br> [[So, you don't trust me?]] <br> [[I sometimes don't trust myself.]] ] } (set: $T2Questions to $T2Questions - 1) (set: $Q25 to 1){<span class="t2"> (if: $starT2 is "starsick")[ I can also recover out here. In the stars. <br> I think it may be better for me, too, without all the stresses of earth. <br> No twisting of knives in my problems down there, causing me to bleed more. <br> Up here I can deal with everything, with myself. <br> <br> <br> [[Can you deal with yourself?]] <br> [[You're an escapist, T2. You're running away.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "excited")[ I'll still recover even if it's not the best medical treatment. <br> (With my treatment out here, ASTRA better have good insurance policies.) <br> I'm able to finally have that adventurous experience that expedition promised me. <br> Without all the liabilities I signed off on earlier. <br> ...are they still liable? <br> <br> <br> [[Did they know about the greens beforehand?]] <br> [[Can't collect on it if you're not back home.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "angry")[ What else do I have to recover from? <br> My body is healing up fine. I'm still chronically dehydrated from that occupier, but I'm getting my fluids. <br> (Unless: $waterrec is 1)[I'm glad Taylor ended up fixing the water reclamation unit. We don't have to ration water.] (else:)[Unfortunately we have to ration our water supply until Taylor fixes the water reclamation unit. Didn't have time to before.] <br> Altogether I'm doing alright, Doc. <br> <br> <br> [[Some wounds are psych-based.]] <br> [[You're the expert on yourself, I guess.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "scared")[ ...Do you think there's something really wrong with me? <br> Of course there is. Who am I kidding and why would I ask? <br> That green wrecked my body going in and coming out. It's a strange miracle that I'm not questioning how I survived up to now. <br> Larry Purvis didn't survive his experiences with an alien in his chest. <br> So why should I? <br> <br> <br> [[Like I said: Earth will help.]] <br> [[Larry Purvis didn't have Taylor and me.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "lonely")[ Thanks for keeping a watchful eye on my mental and physical health, lifeline. <br> You're right: Earth has the medical and recovery services I need. <br> I don't and can't expect you to be my therapist. You've been a good friend and helped so much, but it's different. <br> I don't know, though. Earth has a darn lot of other stuff that isn't helpful to me and stressed me out when I was planetside. <br> <br> <br> [[Can't be worse than the Greens.]] <br> [[I can help. I promise.]] ] } (set: $T2Questions to $T2Questions - 1) (set: $Q26 to 1){<span class="t2"> (if: $starT2 is "starsick")[ <span class="t2"> They will. I'm sure they'll always miss me. <br> I'm my parents' kid. Their little Po-Taylor-Tot. <br> My siblings' hey-give-that-back-stop-poking me. <br> They already miss me, if I'm being honest. <br> From the moment I told them I won that lottery they were beginning to miss me. <br> Isn't it all too human, to miss something before it's even gone? <br> <br> <br> [[Do you miss them?]] <br> [[You don't have to be gone.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "excited")[ <span class="t2"> They missed me as soon as they knew I was leaving, and doubly so— triply so!— when I left. <br> We're all very close and had regular phone and video calls every week during camps and when I had training. <br> It's normal. Families always miss each other when they're close. <br> You always hope you'll go back and the missing becomes missing missing the person as it devolves into family chaos. <br> <br> <br> [[Testy family drama?]] <br> [[Miss Missing You, such a good song.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "angry")[ <span class="t2"> Of course they will. They already do. <br> I doubt they're holding out much hope for my surprise triumphant return. <br> ASTRA is great at informing the risks and their PR and AR (astronaut relations) department is very clear on what to expect and what can be done about it. <br> So, sure, they'll miss me, but it won't change what's already happening. <br> They're living their own lives back on earth. <br> Making new memories. Without me. <br> <br> <br> [[Tell me a happy memory.]] <br> [[Tell me a sad memory.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "scared")[ <span class="t2"> Sure they will. I miss them too. <br> I worry that they'll miss the Taylor that left and not be thankful for the Taylor that returns. <br> The two Taylors that return, that is. <br> Two for the price of one and the value of one. <br> ....I'm being harsh on myself. <br> <br> <br> [[Together you make more than two.]] <br> [[It prepares you for the worst.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "lonely")[ <span class="t2"> I know they will. I miss them too. <br> I miss the way we all would slowly eat breakfast in the morning— more like zombies mindlessly eating flesh than any cereal savoring. <br> I miss the way we would lay on the carpet and build bridges out of toothpicks and glue— and get glue all over the carpet and try to hide it under furniture we rearranged. <br> I miss the way we used to have movie nights and pick bottom-shelf movies from rental stores to find our new classic. <br> I wonder if they're still doing that... those things, without me. <br> <br> <br> [[Would you rather they stop?]] <br> [[There's no reason they would stop.]] ] } (set: $T2Questions to $T2Questions - 1) (set: $Q16 to 1){<span class="t2"> (if: $starT2 is "starsick")[ <span class="t2"> The truth is: they died. <br> They were lost in the attack. <br> MIA, suspected dead is, unfortunately, pretty much dead. <br> They all know what happened. <br> <br> <br> [[You're MIA too, then.]] <br> [[What about the hope they may have?]]] (if: $starT2 is "excited")[ <span class="t2"> They sure do deserve the truth. The truth might benefit the world in ways too. <br> The Varia wasn't the only ship to get shot down on that cursed moon, so maybe we could save a few more people, with the truth. <br> Maybe they could protect others on Earth, get a whole big organization committed to eradicating them! <br> We've done it to smallpox. Occupiers could be next. <br> Can you eradicate parasites? <br> <br> <br> [[Not the point, T2.]] <br> [[Guinea worm is on the way out.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "angry")[ <span class="t2"> So they can get just as angry as us? <br> So they can want revenge just like me? <br> You must be nuts. That revenge gave me nothing. If anything it got me to //this point//. <br> I'm mad at myself for just how much I want some revenge. <br> And I //still// want it. <br> <br> <br> [[Really going all Gully at me, huh.]] <br> [[Is it so bad to want revenge?]] ] (if: $starT2 is "scared")[ <span class="t2"> There's not much of the truth to know besides that they were killed. <br> The details aren't something that needs sharing. <br> (That's why we never told you the details when we found them this time around.) <br> Their families will sleep better at night thinking—//knowing//— that their loved ones are stardust. <br> <br> <br> [[So you want to hide everything?]] <br> [[You know you can't get revenge that way.]]] (if: $starT2 is "lonely")[ <span class="t2"> Sure they deserve the truth, but it's only going to hurt them. <br> The crew's families have already been hurt once, and I'm sure they're going through this grieving the normal way. <br> (ASTRA does give you a little prep checklist on that front, but it always felt like Vogon buerocratic nonsense.) <br> (And not real dumbbell-weight decisions.) <br> <br> <br> [[Listen to the Vogons.]] <br> [[A prep checklist?]] ] } (set: $T2Questions to $T2Questions - 1) (set: $Q28 to 1){<span class="t2"> (if: $starT2 is "starsick")[ We can't get bored in space on this adventure. <br> There's so much to see. So much to do. <br> So much to plan. <br> Did you know there are maybe 400 billion stars in the Milky Way? <br> That's almost, well, 401 billion stars. <br> That's almost 401 billion adventures, right there. <br> Not even accounting for planets and moons to explore. <br> <br> <br> [[Not as many planets as stars.]] <br> [[Seeing a star counts as an adventure?]] ] (if: $starT2 is "excited")[ Do you have any idea how big space is? <br> There's so much to see and do! <br> We could peruse the planets, sightsee at the stars, nap near the nebulae... <br> And that doesn't even mention all the cool parts we don't even know about yet! <br> <br> <br> [[Dangerous cool parts.]] <br> [[No human interaction!]] ] (if: $starT2 is "angry")[ I'll get bored anywhere. <br> The number of science fair projects I completed was a testament not to my level of knowledge but to my level of boredom. <br> So many //Collema nigrescens// and //Letharia vulpina//..... <br> This place has TONS more to do! <br> <br> <br> [[So much work and chores to do.]] <br> [[Were you really bored?]] ] (if: $starT2 is "scared")[ But being bored is better than being an experiment. <br> Any boredom here is better than solitary confinement back at home—I mean, on Earth. <br> Because I can't guarantee that I would be allowed home. <br> Family game night would not be the same in our house. <br> Taylor and I would fight over which color of game pieces we'd be. <br> I always preferred blue and there are rarely orange pieces left. <br> <br> <br> [[I didn't know your favorite color was blue.]] <br> [[You don't think they would want you home?]] ] (if: $starT2 is "lonely")[ You severely underestimate the number of games we know how to play with three people. <br> When dad was at work and mom was working in her office the three of us siblings got into so much trouble. <br> Played fun games like Cheating Uno. <br> Or Presidential Checkers. <br> <br> <br> [[You have two people not three.]] <br> [[What's Cheating Uno?]] ] } (set: $T2Questions to $T2Questions - 1) (set: $Q29 to 1){<span class="t2"> (if: $starT2 is "starsick")[ <span class="t2"> The best revenge is living well, and flashing a smile at the poor sod while you're doing it. <br> It felt good to "deal" with them as I did earlier. Maybe I got that out of my system. <br> And now I can let that go. <br> ....maybe Taylor was right. <br> We can't bring me back home. <br> <br> <br> [[There will be time to deal with them at home.]] <br> [[Of course we can bring you home.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "excited")[ <span class="t2"> ....I kinda still do, actually. <br> I thought that maybe having enough scares and a few small victories would tap those feelings down to manageable levels.... <br> ...but deep down? I don't know if I'm done yet. <br> <br> <br> [[So you'll stay in space for revenge?]] <br> [[They're not done yet either.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "angry")[ <span class="t2"> Yes! <br> And perhaps it's best for them to stay far away from me, now that they know. (If: $greeneyes is 1)[<br>You hear that? Er, you see that?! Away with you!] <br> If they knew what would come for them if I have my way they would force me to stay out here forever just so they can enact their own plans elsewhere. <br> ..... <br> Huh. <br> <br> <br> [[Catching on finally, geez.]] <br> [[Going home would lead to that confrontation.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "scared")[ <span class="t2"> I got some of my vengeance drive sorted out while dealing with that crowd of visitors. <br> (If: $tort is 0)[One hard kick out the airlock wasn't enough but it felt good.] (else:)[You know that felt good. Hopefully you enjoyed it too.] <br> The only question there is, is this: <br> Can I still function driven by revenge or will I be completely consumed by it? <br> <br> <br> [[Be careful about it, I guess.]] <br> [[Okay, Gully.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "lonely")[ <span class="t2"> I would like revenge on them, that's true. <br> When I think of what I'd do to them, I smile enough that I feel my face crinkle across my scars. <br> That's another reminder of what I can do to myself just for revenge. <br> There was that old saying, how did it go again? <br> When you set out for revenge, dig how many graves? <br> <br> <br> [[Two graves.]] <br> [[Three graves.]] ] } (set: $T2Questions to $T2Questions - 1) (set: $Q30 to 1){<span class="t2"> (if: $starT2 is "starsick")[ <span class="t2"> No, we won't be alone. <br> We'll have each other and the stars. <br> And you. <br> We can explore and meet others out there, also exploring the vastness of space. <br> We'll never be alone. <br> <br> <br> [[You were sad about loneliness before.]] <br> [[There's a LOT of vast space.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "excited")[ <span class="t2"> I won't be alone. I'm going to have Taylor with me, like it or not. <br> And you, of course. No family or other friends. <br> I DO have an idea, a brilliant idea. <br> An absolutely wonderful terrible idea. <br> We could reach out to other spaceships as penpals! <br> Nothing will replace you and Taylor will do the coding. <br> What do you say for a cure to that loneliness? <br> <br> <br> [[Only ever looking over Taylor's shoulder.]] <br> [[And give the Green Squad another chance?]] ] (if: $starT2 is "angry")[ <span class="t2"> I've dealt with being alone before. I'm almost used to it by now. <br> Hell, it's been, what, several months with only the Varia crew, or the White Star crew, or Taylor and you? <br> I can deal with limited people in my life after all. <br> I've adapted to a life like this. <br> One might say like lichen, but lichen is a symbiotic relationship between algae and ascomycetes so perhaps the metaphor breaks down there. <br> One might say it breaks down like lichen breaks down upon heavy exposure to UV light in the vacuum of space. <br> <br> <br> [[That's a lot of people who've been with on this journey.]] <br> [[One might say you'll break down like lichen.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "scared")[ <span class="t2"> That's the point— to be away from the Greens. If we're not with them we'll be alone. <br> If we're not with anyone else, then that'll be another problem. <br> We can meet others for lunch at the restaurant at the other side of the galaxy. Once we meet them. <br> If they're safe and not more vicious space pirates than us. <br> <br> <br> [[No one to help if things go wrong.]] <br> [[What if no one is working at the restaurant?]] ] (if: $starT2 is "lonely")[ <span class="t2"> There's you, Taylor, and.... <br> `[T2 is drawing on a few fingers.]` <br> The gang's all here! <br> <br> <br> [[That's just plain sad.]] <br> [[Not a good example of mental stability.]] ] } (set: $T2Questions to $T2Questions - 1) (set: $Q31 to 1){ (if: $starTay is "starsick")[ Spending time with them both and seeing the people I grew up with grow up themselves. <br> I could get behind that. <br> But, isn't that a lot of sacrifice of my own happiness just to be on the lookout for their life? <br> They wouldn't see what I grow up to do since I tossed it to watch them. <br> <br> <br> [[The comb and the watch winder.]] <br> [[You'll spend your lives together.]] ] (if: $starTay is "excited")[ I already have a guess for what those will do. <br> It's a guess though, nothing bigger than that. <br> My brother was interested in library systems and my sister was interested in business management. <br> A wide spread of career choices in my family. <br> Both have good heads on their shoulders too. <br> Nothing beats Student Astronaut Turned Star Explorer Space Pirate Extraordinaire. <br> <br> <br> [[They'll never find out what you grow up to do.]] <br> [[Calm down that rivalry, Taylor.]] ] (if: $starTay is "angry")[ Why the sudden interest in them? I love them but I'm not joined at the hip with them. <br> I mean, me and my sister DID win the three legged race five years running at the block party and the other few years it was me and my brother. <br> Point still stands that I'm here to talk to and about and not them. <br> <br> <br> [[Ah. Sibling tensions.]] <br> [[What's got your goat?]] ] (if: $starTay is "scared")[ That would be great to see! <br> They're both so smart and kind and curious about everything— the possibilities are endless. <br> They'll both be successful anywhere they go. <br> Me? <br> I'm tired. I'm traumatized. I'll need medical intervention the second I land. <br> Who knows what will happen to T2. Will we split up? Will family accept us both? <br> And in regards to my own career.... <br> ....I'll be grounded for life. <br> <br> <br> [[Your parents can't be that strict.]] <br> [[Don't catastrophize for T2 too.]] ] (if: $starTay is "lonely")[ They'll both be successful. Absolutely. <br> Whether that's in academics or library science or business management or blowing up buildings for science fairs. <br> (The last one is me.) <br> (I wish.) <br> Facts are that they'll be okay no matter what they do and will find and grow happy families. <br> I'm not sure about myself at this point and I don't want to be left and abandoned if I go back. <br> <br> <br> [[You want love?]] <br> [[They literally will not abandon you.]] ] } (set: $TayQuestions to $TayQuestions - 1) (set: $Q32 to 1){<span class="t2"> (if: $starT2 is "starsick")[ <span class="t2"> That comment was mostly a joke. <br> Mostly. <br> There are a lot of hidden pathways around these sectors. <br> I'm sure we can throw them off our tails. <br> <br> <br> [[How do you know where they are?]] <br> [[A joke but also implied to be true.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "excited")[ <span class="t2"> Eventually they may find us but we won't go quietly! <br> Okay, maybe we will since you don't talk to cops, celestial or terrestrial, but until the point our hands are in tight laser-gravity handcuffs we will fight to the end! <br> That doesn't scare me— I've faced aliens around and inside me. <br> A few space cops are nothing. <br> <br> <br> [[Didn't you give up before?]] <br> [[The legal ramifications would be a headache.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "angry")[ <span class="t2"> Screw the space police. <br> Screw the earth police too, by the way. <br> Even the ones you find good and lovable. <br> I mean, It's the idea of going after the bad guys that you love, right? But they don't. <br> And they especially won't NOT go after the guys who stole a spaceship and are traveling through space uncharted. <br> I do love a good formal uniform but I also love the rustic space punk getup. <br> <br> <br> [[I'm a fan of uniforms, kid.]] <br> [[Space punk is the space funk!]] ] (if: $starT2 is "scared")[ <span class="t2"> I'm not scared of some space police. <br> I was mostly kidding, too, but there are other organizations out here. <br> Few and far between, for everything that we can do with space travel. <br> It's pretty lawless so we could squeeze in here, find ourselves a corner to carve out and make our own way. <br> <br> <br> [[I admit you have a cool theme going.]] <br> [[Taylor won't be cool with the whole pirate thing.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "lonely")[ <span class="t2"> It's a large galaxy. I doubt it would be soon. <br> We'd have time to adjust to this new lifestyle before we'd have to deal with the space po-po. <br> They mostly patrol around the trade routes. You know. To make sure people aren't smuggling moon rocks or magic space rocks. <br> There's a market for that back home. <br> One organization or another wants that shiny stuff in bulk. <br> Even in Austin. <br> <br> <br> [[PWG?]] <br> [[Pearson Co.?]]] } (set: $T2Questions to $T2Questions - 1) (set: $Q33 to 1){<span class="t2"> (if: $starT2 is "starsick")[ I think it's easier this way. <br> They get to be at peace with a final resting place. <br> It's not uncommon for accidents to happen. Spacetravel is dangerous. <br> Really dangerous. <br> I'd just be one of the many astronauts who have died for the cause of exploration. <br> <br> <br> [[You will be dead.]] <br> [[But you aren't dead.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "excited")[ I suppose they should know, yeah. <br> But consider this: they would be happier if they didn't know how hard this was. <br> They'd also be happier not knowing what we'd have to do out here to survive. <br> That's the truth of the space pirate business, sorry. <br> <br> <br> [[I'll report you.]] <br> [[They'd be sadder knowing you're giving them up.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "angry")[ No. No they don't. <br> They don't deserve to know how much pain I went through, how much I suffered... <br> ...and how no matter how much they would want to change it... <br> ...the damage has been done. <br> To their child. <br> Heartbreaking. <br> <br> <br> [[A real tearjerker.]] <br> [[You're still you, under all those scars.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "scared")[ I suppose they should be told. <br> I don't know how to say it, and I don't want to be the one to say it. <br> "Hey, Mom! Your kid is dead and we—your kids from another universe, one who was infected by an alien parasite— are here to be your new kid!" <br> "No, Dad, don't cry! I know we can be a bit much to handle and now there are TWO of us, but—" <br> "What's that, Mom? You're freaked out by my eyes and I can't be your kid?" <br> "Oh, okay. Fine. That's what I expected." <br> "I'll be seeing you then. Sometime. Somehow." <br> <br> <br> [[They love you, T2.]] <br> [[You're scared of them?]] ] (if: $starT2 is "lonely")[ Mom and Dad should be told what happened. The truth, not what happened here. <br> I mean, they were told what happened to THEIR Taylor. The one that died on this ship. The one from THIS universe. <br> Not the two trying to slip into the shoes and pretend that there's nothing wrong in the odd scenario. <br> I'm assuming that there's no difference between these three Taylors on board. <br> Even though I'm from a different universe than Taylor—most likely— all the belongings we found of this Varia's Taylor matches ours exactly. <br> (It was nice to get our tablet back with the rest of EverAfter and Spoonbenders that I didn't get to finish). <br> I don't foresee any universe-shocks with universe differences... but... <br> I don't want to forget this Taylor, here. <br> <br> <br> [[You won't forget this Taylor.]] <br> [[You'll both fit in just fine.]] ] } (set: $T2Questions to $T2Questions - 1) (set: $Q34 to 1){<span class="t2"> (if: $starT2 is "starsick")[ I'm not abandoning you. You're good to have around. <br> I'd offer a space on the shuttle to you, if you were able to take it.</span> <br> <br> <br> [[I respectfully decline.]] <br> [[I disrespectfully decline.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "excited")[ { Of course not! I'm not leaving you. <br> I actually like you, as weird as you were at first, I immediately understood why Taylor adored you so much. <br> Now? <br> I couldn't get you away from me ever— we're like stink on good Texan range manure. <br> And that, my good friend, is a compliment. <br> <br> <br> [[You lost me at the manure.]] <br> [[Flies on stink, eh?]] ] (if: $starT2 is "angry")[ { It's not leaving or abandoning! <br> I'd still be able to talk to you! <br> If I wanted to leave I would have already. And you with me. <br> And that has to count for something, doesn't it? <br> <br> <br> [[It really does, T2.]] <br> [[Have you heard of nihilism?]] ] (if: $starT2 is "scared")[Abandon you? Is staying in space really what you'd call abandoning you? <br> I'm still going to be in communication. I'm not turning off my comms. <br> Same thing would happen on Earth— I wouldn't turn off my comms. <br> Unless you would? <br> <br> <br> [[Never.]] <br> [[I'm tired, T2.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "lonely")[ Of course not. I actually regrettably like having you around. <br> I should be offering you a spot in the spaceship. <br> So you can bother me (affectionate) out here in the flesh. <br> Two can be lonely. Three's a crowd. <br> <br> <br> [[You bother me (affectionate) from here already.]] <br> [[No, I get seasick, starsick, whatever.]] ] } (set: $T2Questions to $T2Questions - 1) (set: $Q35 to 1){<span class="t2"> (if: $starT2 is "starsick")[Beautiful stars. <br> An entire sky of them. <br> They're endless and clear. <br> So so many little points of lights in the darkness. <br> <br> <br> [[You can see them from the ground.]] <br> [[Little flecks of light. That's it?]] ] (if: $starT2 is "excited")[ Space has so much stuff! It has the space to hold it all too! <br> Besides all the classes of stars—O, B, A, F, G, K, M— <br> —there's also the types of planets astronomers keep finding! <br> Gas giants that rain diamonds... planets with vast oceans... planets with extreme geometric orbits... <br> And the moons! And the asteroids! <br> <br> <br> [[And the aliens!]] <br> [[Earth has cool stuff too...]] ] (if: $starT2 is "angry")[ Oh, I don't know. With the number of stars and the number of planets out there... <br> ....there's also bound to be more Earths to explore everything Earth has to offer too. <br> <br> <br> [[What's the probability of math?]] <br> [[Not the people, though.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "scared")[ Oh man. Lots of danger, that's for sure. <br> But also, a lack of //Earth// danger, that's for sure. <br> And a lack of a lot of //personal// Earth danger, that's for doubly sure. <br> <br> <br> [[Taylor won't let it come to that.]] <br> [[You'll break the loop I swear.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "lonely")[ A lot of empty space, that's for sure. <br> But it can't be a waste of space, maybe there's more life out there. <br> Life that isn't parasitic alien blobs that want to take over the universe as we know it. <br> <br> <br> [[Sagan mentioned that.]] <br> [[It could be dangerous in other ways.]] ] } (set: $T2Questions to $T2Questions - 1) (set: $Q36 to 1){<span class="t2"> (if: $starT2 is "starsick")[ <span class="t2"> I think we'll be able to handle anything that comes our way. <br> I'm feeling confident right now. <br> If we get hurt we can fix it. We can hail for some help. <br> We can get hurt on Earth too. <br> <br> <br> [[But also helped on Earth.]] <br> [[Usually not explosive decompression though.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "excited")[ <span class="t2"> Yeah that's kinda par the course for life out here, isn't it? <br> We sail along, we meet trouble, we get into it, and we get out of it but with some bruises or more. <br> BUT! <br> We get out of it. <br> That's the most important part. <br> <br> <br> [[It is, but....]] <br> [[You barely know first aid.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "angry")[ <span class="t2"> That's par the course for me. I'm clumsy, and I stub my toe on everything. <br> What's also par the course for me is being able to clean myself up. <br> I know //basic// first aid. <br> For the most part. <br> And if I don't, then I don't and that's unfortunately it. <br> <br> <br> [[So you'd give up?]] <br> [[Then that's that. Come home.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "scared")[ <span class="t2"> I am, as others and myself have profusely said, a butterfingers and a clutz. <br> Not the candy type or the childrens' craft books either. <br> If there's a way for me to get hurt from something, I'll likely find it through experience. <br> <br> <br> [[Testing for Murphy, eh?]] <br> [[You're a celestial crash dummy.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "lonely")[ <span class="t2"> I'll have Taylor to help patch me up. <br> Taylor has been helpful before. Why should that change? <br> And if Taylor gets hurt I can also help. Like we've always done for each other. <br> Well... after we stopped being our own worst enemies. <br> <br> <br> [[You do make a good team, surprisingly.]] <br> [[Are you sure Taylor can handle what comes your way?]] ] } (set: $T2Questions to $T2Questions - 1) (set: $Q37 to 1){<span class="t2"> (if: $starT2 is "starsick")[ <span class="t2"> I'm thinking, I'm thinking. <br> Lots of white and blue and of course green. <br> Pale blue amid all the darkness of the universe— it's a pretty sight, I'll give you that. <br> But there are so many other colors in the universe to see besides those three. <br> <br> <br> [[No, no. The colors ON Earth.]] <br> [[But can you touch those?]] ] (if: $starT2 is "excited")[ <span class="t2"> Oh man. I could spend forever on that task. <br> I'm thinking of only the colors of the skies on earth. <br> White. <br> Pale blue. <br> Baby's breath blue. <br> Robin's egg blue. <br> Blue. <br> Savoy. <br> Chefchaouen. <br> Cerulean. <br> Teal. <br> Olive. <br> Moss green. <br> Yellow. <br> Golden. <br> Xanthous. <br> Tangelo. <br> Burnt Orange. <br> Brown. <br> Black. <br> Stars. <br> Gray. <br> Grey. <br> Lavender. <br> Sky Lavender. <br> Peach. <br> Coral. <br> Papaya. <br> Buttercream. <br> Tan. <br> Beige— <br> <br> <br> [[Which one?]] <br> [[Absolutely not. I'm scrolling away.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "angry")[ <span class="t2"> Alrighty. Blue, GREEN, tan, white, grey... <br> Every color in the rainbow since every rainbow is on Earth. <br> ...and THAT observation will not make me change my answer because it is ALSO incorrect. <br> Other planets and moons have water and light to make their own rainbows. Without Sol and Earth! <br> <br> <br> [[Do other liquids prism like that?]] <br> [[And with blackjack!]] ] (if: $starT2 is "scared")[ <span class="t2"> Why? I'm not seeing the reasoning here. <br> It's colorful in contrast to everything aboard this ship. Is that it? <br> The Varia is mostly greys and grays and silvers and rainbow (but mostly blue) LED light. <br> Earth's got everything. Are you trying to make me homesick? <br> <br> <br> [[I'm trying to make you homestuck.]] <br> [[It's meditative, I swear.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "lonely")[ <span class="t2"> Oh man, I see what you're doing. <br> You're trying to guilt me into being nostalgic and whatnot for Earth. <br> Hey, guess what? <br> It's working. <br> There are so many colors, all the colors of the rainbow. Namely because rainbows are on the planet. <br> Not every rainbow in the universe since it is just light refraction. <br> <br> <br> [[But how do those rainbows compare?]] <br> [[Is the nostalgia guilt working?]] ] } (set: $T2Questions to $T2Questions - 1) (set: $Q38 to 1){<span class="t2"> (if: $starT2 is "starsick")[ As cool as that would be, Lifeline, I don't think the award matters. <br> I'd love that recognition but it's helping people that makes it worthwhile. <br> Can't I q-comm the design elements to you so you can get that sweet option money and the fame? <br> For helping me out so much? <br> What am I going to do with money out here anyway. <br> <br> <br> [[So now I have to do more work?]] <br> [[You and Taylor both LOVE the sweet option money.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "excited")[ You really mean it? <br> You really think that my terrible and dangerous and no good very very bad idea... <br> ...was actually a marvelous and useful and yes good very very good idea? <br> <br> <br> [[You're making me reconsider.]] <br> [[I really do, T2.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "angry")[ Thanks for the encouragement, but I don't know if I can patent that trick. <br> It's super dangerous, and off the cuff so much the cuff is back near [deep space object]. <br> There has to be loads more calculations to fine tune that contraption that I am not able to do with my wonderful math skills. <br> It's dead in the water. <br> <br> <br> [[At least not dead in deep space.]] <br> [[Well, you'd have a team to help you out.]] ] (if: $starT2 is "scared")[ I know, I know. Logan had some markings that can only be described as "as of a cow." Those were good times spent in the lab instead of the peak. [[$TayExcited->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "excited") .....I asked way too much of you, didn't it, and took you for granted. [[$TayLonely->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "lonely").......... ........I'm so sorry, lifeline. I asked //way// too much from you. I'm sorry. [[$TayLonely->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "lonely")That's true, I usually don't have a backup plan, and certainly wouldn't have much in the way of master plans if it wasn't for you, lifeline. [[$TayStarsick->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNOGO to $TAYNOGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "starsick")It's not playing with timeloops. It's not messing with them either. It's refusing to let the consequences happen. [[$TayExcited->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNOGO to $TAYNOGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "excited")So it is. A shame. No, it... really puts a damper on the movie idea. [[$TayExcited->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNOGO to $TAYNOGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "excited")Yeah? T2 is a Taylor too. I know this, lifeline. I've had that existential crisis a few times already. [[$TayScared->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "scared")Exactly. If this is a big issue for them they can clean up the mess themselves. I'm not their maid. [[$TayStarsick->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNOGO to $TAYNOGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "starsick")Oh, I see what you're doing. It's reverse psychology. [[$TayStarsick->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "starsick")Oh, I see what you're doing. It's reverse reverse psychology! [[$TayStarsick->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNEU to $TAYNEU + 1) (set: $starTay to "starsick")They //totally// are strong. Super strong. Supernaturally strong. [[$TayStarsick->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNEU to $TAYNEU + 1) (set: $starTay to "starsick")She was my role model, and I wish her the best with her baby. Oh man, I hope they both make it back home safe. [[$TayStarsick->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNOGO to $TAYNOGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "starsick") I will be safe, Lifeline. You, T2, and the Stars keep me safe. [[$TayStarsick->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNOGO to $TAYNOGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "starsick")Oh no not the 'quencies! Ugh. Those 'quencies really get you in these spacetravel times. [[$TayExcited->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNEU to $TAYNEU + 1) (set: $starTay to "excited")I haven't given up hope. Hope is something you can do without any action. Might I remind you of my grandma's saying? [[$TayAngry->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "Angry")Yeah, Lifeline, I //know//. I may be a dreamer but I'm not only one. I can also be a realist. [[$TayAngry->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "Angry")I know I'm not but maybe I will be. If Mari lives and makes it back to Earth and doesn't have anyone else she'd name. [[$TayScared->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "scared")I will miss being around people. That was what I missed most of all when I crashed on that moon. [[$TayLonely->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "lonely")You sound so angry despite there being only punctuation. How would this hurt you? I'd just be staying out here, not dying. That still feels weird to say since I'm very alive right now and intend to stay that way, thank you very much, greens and the apathetic forces of entropy. I want to live. I want to live my life that you tried so hard to save. Please tell me that isn't selfish. [[$TayAngry->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNOGO to $TAYNOGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "angry")Aw what can I say when you're being so polite? Or so desperate, which makes me feel guilty about this talk. [[$TayStarsick->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNOGO to $TAYNOGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "starsick")Oh man. Lifeline, why do you have to tug my heartstrings? What about you? The heartbeat of a pulsar in the remnants of a supernova. [[$TayLonely->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "lonely")That's the hardest part of all— coming home. [[$TayExcited->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNOGO to $TAYNOGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "excited")Not required, but I have a feeling it's appreciated. I probably owe you a few life debts. Feel free to cash in whenever I'm around. .... Which means I might have to listen to you. [[$TayExcited->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "excited")You know that's not true! It's going to be nonstop stress when I get back there. From dealing with ASTRA to explaining T2 to making sure no one hurts my twin to greeting my family to explain everything that happened and not get called crazy to making sure everything else is the same in this crazy universe. There never has been. [[$TayAngry->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNOGO to $TAYNOGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "angry")Hey, you're right. I said "make a choice" not "choose a particular path." Choices scare me since I know I could flip the coin wrong and end up smeared across the steel hull of the ship. The greens' offer has always been to no longer get a choice. That's scary— you lose everything even condiment preferences (it's //always// verde sauce)... ...but you gain a reassurance from no longer second guessing every move. You know you can simply follow. Unless the choice is for ghost pepper sauce. Then I'm morally obligated to save my tastebuds and stomach lining and abstain. [[$TayExcited->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "excited")Oh come on! As Tom Petty says: The waaaaaiting is the hardest part! The anxious anticipation for when the movie starts and maybe you could have ran off to the bathroom but now you can't but you could have if you just left so go now but you missed your chance. I don't want to hang on anymore and continue until I don't know when. You don't know when! I need a break! To relax! I'm burnt out. I want to shine. [[$TayAngry->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNOGO to $TAYNOGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "angry")Their home can be my home. Maybe I was meant to be at home among the Stars. Isn't that everything we've been discussing? [[$TayStarsick->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNOGO to $TAYNOGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "starsick")It's not that easy, lifeline. If it was this discussion would have been over by now, in your favor. I trust my physical being, with all its molecular structure built from the burning and shining of so many stars. It's innate. It's not so easy to dismiss. [[$TayStarsick->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNOGO to $TAYNOGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "starsick")Oh man. You have? Where was it? Yellowstone? Key West? La Rumorosa? I suppose there's a difference seeing them through earth's atmosphere— a mile of nitrogen and other gas.... ....and seeing them from up here, next to them. With them. They don't twinkle out here without that atmosphere but they're so bright, lifeline. They're so bright and I can feel them burning and shining. [[$TayStarsick->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNOGO to $TAYNOGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "starsick")Well, aren't you full of knowledge. I bet you have a full psychological profile of me in your hands on your comms device. Maybe there's a barrier of atmosphere and stardust in the way. [[$TayExcited->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNEU to $TAYNEU + 1) (set: $starTay to "excited")No smog in the desert! Even less on a desert moon! You're right— is IS clearer in the desert with the dry air and no clouds and wonderful weather. (I'm Texan after all!) [[$TayLonely->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "lonely")"Beautiful... just beautiful!" He's a companion and friend through it all. God, I so badly want to hug him one more time. I hope he has a lot of happy memories of me, I surely do for him. And I hope he's alright. [[$TayExcited->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "excited")Hey! I didn't know that fun fact. I studied a whole bunch of biology systems and taxonomy and my mind is blown. We've gotta find some key lime pie plants, or the regional variant: lemon meringue. You're SO knowledgeable about plant hybrids. Do they grow in space? The ceiling height is marginal here. [[$TayExcited->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "excited")I'll have to change my diet, yes. There aren't many animals in space—dogs and rats and a few fish experiments. I don't have it in my heart to raise them and then butcher them for meat. If someone else does it, it's called a yummy hamburger and I graciously dig in. [[$TayStarsick->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNOGO to $TAYNOGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "starsick")So are ghost peppers. They taste like death. Actually, no, that's incorrect. They FEEL LIKE DEATH. Did I ever tell you about that time I dared myself to eat one? I dumped the phone with the video evidence my friends gathered in the Colorado River, but, cloud technology, you know? I pray you will never see it so my dignity will remain intact. [[$TayExcited->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNOGO to $TAYNOGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "excited")Oh. Man. It does. In order to do any planetary exploring we have to land this lovely hunk of metal. That doesn't bother me but the uncontrolled impact surely will. I didn't feel capable of landing the White Star myself, and that ship was smaller and easier to maneuver! ....We'd have to survive off salt and black peppercorn. [[$TayScared->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "scared")Says the person spared from the taste of the powdered beverages. Here, let me show you: Go out to the store and buy some kool-aid mix. Whatever flavor you want, except it has to be orange. Then remove all the sugar and plop it in lukewarm water so it doesn't fully dissolve. I assure you that your walls are safe from demolition by a giant bowl of fruit punch because there is no fruity punch besides regret. [[$TayAngry->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "angry")I am, aren't I? Complaining in addition to humor is one of my coping mechanisms. Cracking jokes about my diet makes the "Powdered Orange Beverage" go down. Like a cynical Mary Poppins. [[$TayAngry->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "angry")As much as I complain, I would not complain about a nice homemade meal cooked with love, or some greasy takeout. I know, I know it's not possible... but a lonely astronaut can dream a little, right? I miss my parents, and grandma and uncle and aunts and cousins and everyone. I miss the food they'd make for holidays or surprise visits. [[$TayLonely->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "Lonely")"Complain complain is all you did I finally had to close the lid." But YOU can't close the lid. Only T2 can, but won't. You'll have complaints in stereo! Doesn't solve the food problem, but it's fun. [[$TayScared->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "scared")By all means, hear me roar then. `*Ahem*` <span class ="comms">`[Taylor is complaining]`</span> How was that? Up to snuff? [[$TayExcited->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNEU to $TAYNEU + 1) (set: $starTay to "excited")<span class="t2">Haha! School's out! for! summer! School's! Out! For! I think the Greens are scarier than a rogue asteroid here or there. They're not sentient... in the same way. I mean, the Greens are sentient hive mind blobs out to kill us. Meteors don't think. They just ARE. And they're not murderers. [[$TayScared->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNOGO to $TAYNOGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "scared")If I do, then I'll live. Like last time. I have you to rely on and help me through things. And I have T2 to help me in person. You make me confident when I'm really not. It's a good feeling. [[$TayScared->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNOGO to $TAYNOGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "scared")Have I had enough bad luck recently to wish for some good luck? That's not something I can answer truthfully. The crash was unlucky, then came you, then the greens showed up, then the White Star showed up.... But now I have this chance, then it might turn out to be crap. [[$TayLonely->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "lonely")Yeah. We'd be on our own out here. I still don't think we'd get hit by a meteor (or asteroid as that's the correct name). [[$TayScared->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "scared")I knew you wouldn't understand. That's okay. [[$TayAngry->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNOGO to $TAYNOGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "angry")Wow. That's some foreboding statement. I thought you'd trust me enough to not get randomly killed. I can't. I refuse. [[$TayAngry->SSTS]] (set: $TAYNOGO to $TAYNOGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "angry")There are... things out here. Wow that sounded a bit desperate. There are things out here! [[$TayLonely->SSTS]] (set: $TAYGO to $TAYGO + 1) (set: $starTay to "lonely")Can't say my arm improved since the Great Glowstick Shotput of Tau Ceti IV. It's still a weak swing. If I even hit it. And general bodyaches from being turned into linguini from that black hole. And my stomachache from a lack of linguini. And Cadet Taylor, at your service, if that wasn't obvious by now. [[Not obvious enough.]] [[Who else would I be talking to?]]It's not a creative color either. All my best scientific thinking happens in a landscape of flashing red pan-system alarms. Where the only alternative is to add two green eyes to the Christmas color mix. All things considered, black hole aside, I am alright. And Cadet Taylor, at your service, if that wasn't obvious by now.
